theorems.name: Submission.eilenberg_compact_hausdorff_eq_iSup_open_content
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MetricSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (k : ℝ) (F : Set X), 0 < k → IsCompact F → MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure k F = ⨆ n : ℕ, ⨅ (I : Finset ℕ) (O : ℕ → Set X) (_ : ∀ i ∈ I, IsOpen (O i) ∧ Metric.ediam (O i) < ((n : ℝ≥0∞) + 1)⁻¹) (_ : F ⊆ ⋃ i ∈ I, O i), ∑ i ∈ I, Metric.ediam (O i) ^ k
